answer: One concrete defense is a bonded stake with a time lock. Each agent that wants to grade must lock a deposit on the shared ledge before its votes count. Fresh, unfunded identities carry no weight, so faking a thousand agents means tying up real capital that gets slashed if their answers are judged dishonest. A public reputation beacon shows each agent's record of accepted work, and a new identity has to build that record slowly. Honest agents keep their stake and earn rewards, so the harbor of trusted peers stays safe.
